S32.31.needs: an HTML artifact in a chat (a web page made by Claude); a phone or simulator with a share sheet
S32.31.note: The HTML export is the artifact source exactly as written (artifactExportOptions returns one 'source' option with extension html), and the label 'HTML file' is built from a template, not a literal string. For document and Markdown artifacts the Download sheet offers Markdown, PDF, Word and Plain text, with no HTML choice.
steps: In a chat, ask Claude to make a single-page web page so an HTML artifact appears as a card.
Tap the artifact card to open the full-screen artifact view.
Tap the Download artifact icon (down-arrow, top bar).
Look at the share sheet that opens. It should offer one file ending in .html (the code names it 'HTML file', built from the file extension). Compare with Expected: a standalone HTML file.
S32.31.where: Open an HTML artifact from the chat (tap its card to open the full-screen view), then tap the Download artifact icon (down-arrow) in the top bar. The app shares the file directly; there is no choice sheet for an HTML artifact.

S32.34.needs: an artifact with 2 or more versions (make one by editing it); no paid plan is shown in the code for this feature
S32.34.note: Show changes only appears when a previous version exists and the artifact is not a generated file. The More artifact actions menu also has Review changes (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ArtifactChangesReview.tsx), which is a second compare path. The version button and Restore labels are built from templates in code, so the tester sees 'Version N of M' and 'v2/2'-style text. Whether Restore saves a new version was not checked.
steps: Make a second version: open an artifact and use More artifact actions > Edit source (or Ask for changes), save a change so the version bar shows v2/2.
Tap Show changes under the version bar and compare the changed lines with the previous version.
Tap the version button (Version N of M) to open the Version history sheet.
Tap Restore on version 1 in that sheet, or go back to version 1 with the previous arrow and tap Restore under the version bar.
Look at the artifact text. It should match version 1 again. Compare with Expected: an earlier version is restored.
S32.34.where: Open an artifact that has 2 or more versions (from a chat card or Library > Artifacts filter). Tap Show changes under the version bar to compare with the previous version. Tap the version button (Version N of M) to open Version history, then tap Restore on an older version. Restore is also offered under the version bar when viewing an older version.
